login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your administrator account.
login.temporaryNotice: Signing in with an email and password is temporary and only for development.

home.description: Face recognition and dynamic QR access control system.

errors.invalid_token: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.missing_user_fields: Enter a name and an email.
errors.email_already_exists: A user with this email already exists.
errors.cannot_modify_self: You cannot deactivate yourself or remove your own admin role.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid_input: Check the data you entered: some field is not valid.
errors.sso_not_allowed: This account does not have administrator access. Ask an administrator to add you with this email.
errors.sso_failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.sso_not_configured: Single sign-on is not set up on the server yet.
errors.sso_unavailable: The sign-in provider could not be reached. Check the internet connection. The access point keeps working without internet.
errors.no_face: No face was found. Look straight at the camera.
errors.multiple_faces: More than one face is visible. Only one person should be in front of the camera.
errors.camera_denied: The browser did not allow the camera. Allow it in the site settings and reload.
errors.camera_unavailable: The camera could not be opened. Check that no other app is using it and that the page is on localhost.
errors.face_model_failed: The face model could not be loaded.
errors.camera_not_ready: The camera is not showing a picture yet. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.user_inactive: This user is deactivated. Reactivate them to enroll their face.
errors.face_already_enrolled: This face is already enrolled for another user. If it is the same person, delete the other user's face first.
errors.invalid_terminal_key: The terminal key is not valid. Check the access point settings.
errors.qr_expired: The QR code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.qr_invalid: The QR code is not valid.
errors.qr_already_used: This QR code was already used.
errors.invalid_date_range: The "from" date is after the "to" date.

kiosk.qrFallback: Not recognized? Use a QR code (ask an administrator for one).

setup.title: Set up the access point

enroll.title: Face enrollment
enroll.enrolledSince: Face enrolled on {{date}}. Saving again replaces it.
enroll.consent: The person agrees that their face is turned into numbers and stored to let them in. No photo is kept.
enroll.confirmDelete: Delete this person's face? They can still get in with a QR code.

faceCheck.title: Camera check
faceCheck.subtitle: Checks that the camera and the face model work. The image is not saved or sent anywhere.
faceCheck.result: Face found: a descriptor of {{length}} numbers in {{ms}} ms ({{preview}}, …).

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People registered in the system. Users are deactivated, never deleted.
